sentences.en: During the Boutelfika era, billions of dollars vanished into private coffers.
sentences.zh: 在布特弗利卡时期， billions of dollars 被私人存入了保险箱。

sentences.en: The abbots filled their coffers with the proceeds from selling beer.
sentences.zh: 这些修道士通过卖啤酒赚取的钱装满了他们的保险箱。

sentences.en: The abbots were filling their coffers with the proceeds from selling beer.
sentences.zh: 这些修道士通过卖啤酒赚取的钱正被存入他们的保险箱中。
